purpose: Additive audit of priority regional public-source endpoints inherited from PV Agent or found on official regional portals.

sources.channel: VIA / verifica di assoggettabilità / PAUR / procedimenti attivi
sources.wind_adaptation: Runtime first pass follows same-host VIA/PAUR/project links and filters wind. If no server-rendered project rows are parseable, emit a non-project source_channel_snapshot instead of inventing project data.
sources.audit_note: First-pass adapter implemented. SPA/API deepening is still required if the public platform exposes project rows only client-side.

sources.channel: Autorizzazione Unica FER / volture / regional energy acts
sources.wind_adaptation: Track AU, integrations, volture and final authorisation separately from VIA; cross-link DPC025 determinations and BURA publication.
sources.audit_note: The regional service is competent for FER AU across Abruzzo and explicitly separates the construction/operation title from environmental sub-procedures.

sources.channel: Banca dati procedimenti VIA / PAUR / screening / cartography
sources.wind_adaptation: Runtime adapter monitors the public SIRAVIAVAS in-progress VIA registry, filters wind/repowering rows and keeps national-VIA mirror entries behind a MASE reconciliation guard.
sources.audit_note: Current public registry exposes multiple wind rows; adapter implemented but live runtime behavior still requires controlled execution.

sources.institution: Regione Molise — Servizio Programmazione Politiche Energetiche
sources.channel: Autorizzazioni FER + procedimenti depositati eolico + eolico VIA nazionale
sources.wind_adaptation: Runtime adapter discovers the dedicated Eolico and Eolico-VIA nazionale routes. It emits project findings only for parseable rows; otherwise it records a non-project channel snapshot for SPA/API follow-up.
sources.audit_note: First-pass adapter implemented; endpoint/API deepening remains necessary where the dedicated route is client-rendered.

sources.institution: Regione Marche / Valutazioni e autorizzazioni ambientali
sources.channel: Avvio procedimenti VIA / regional wind projects
sources.wind_adaptation: Runtime adapter filters the official procedure-start registry for wind and extracts project text, MW, municipalities, proponent, procedure and protocol/date when present.
sources.audit_note: The registry exposes concrete wind entries and the first-pass runtime adapter is implemented.

sources.channel: State VIA regional mirror / project documents
sources.wind_adaptation: Use as regional mirror/enrichment for state VIA projects; never duplicate MASE identities. Valuable for local notices and documents.
sources.audit_note: The registry exposes Energia della Comunanza and Mercatello with proponent, MW and project documents.

sources.channel: Autorizzazioni energetiche / AU FER / conferenze di servizi
sources.wind_adaptation: Monitor wind AU and conference notices and distinguish environmental progress from construction authorisation.

sources.channel: VIA / PAUR project list and downloadable project registers
sources.wind_adaptation: PV Agent already paginates the project list and parses date, procedure, proponent, municipality, province and status. Replace PV keyword gate and explicit eolico exclusion with wind/repowering/onshore/offshore terms.
Reuse the working VIAVASWeb navigation/parser; replace PV-only keyword filtering with wind terms and retain procedure/document metadata.

sources.channel: FERAU Autorizzazione Unica FER / provincial competence
sources.wind_adaptation: Keep the inherited environmental collector and add FERAU/provincial AU monitoring; the service page is a route to practices, not project evidence itself.
sources.audit_note: FERAU has been live since April 2026 and covers construction, installation, operation, modification, upgrading and rebuilding of FER plants.

sources.channel: Elenco VIA with project detail and final measures
sources.wind_adaptation: The public VIA list exposes eolico projects, proponent, authority and procedure status; pair it with the regional FER authorization service.
Monitor regional AU/PAUR plus BUR acts for eolico, repowering, BESS and grid-related changes; use project/act pages rather than generic guidance as evidence.

sources.channel: Environmental procedures platform + delegated FER AU
sources.wind_adaptation: Environmental services are regional while FER AU outside state competence is delegated to Province/Città Metropolitana; preserve authority/province identity and use BUR/provincial acts as public fallback.
